test_title: PYST 1: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: How much will the interest be for Rs. 1900 at 9% per annum for 3 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1900

Rate (R) = 9% per annum

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times R times T}{100}

**Calculation:**

SI = dfrac{1900 times 9 times 3}{100}

⇒ SI = dfrac{51300}{100}

⇒ SI = ₹513

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
